user.title: ytube-audio Setup
user.description: Configure the ytube-audio integration. Play audio from YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo, Bandcamp, and 1000+ other sites on your media players.

data_description.proxy_stream: Enable to avoid 403 errors on some media players. Streams audio through HA instead of direct YouTube URLs.
data_description.default_format: m4a (AAC) has best compatibility, opus is highest quality, mp3 for legacy devices.
data_description.cache_dir: Directory to cache yt-dlp data (leave default for most setups)
